Missing fields and explicit JSON null both become None, and therefore pass the existing type/value comparison for expected null. The pinned GD normally emits those fields; this is damaged/incomplete-report acceptance, not a native producer guaranteed failure.

Do not require component interface serialization metadata that GD does not emit. Capture already requires required_row_fields presence.
